not_claiming: Built, not applied to every production tenant — production runs 47 of 51 migrations and lags the repo
The test suite is NOT green: 1,432 of 1,439 pass, 7 fail, and the suite exits 1
Module coverage is 56%; the credits/billing paths and the safety/guardrail layer have zero unit tests
There is no server CI — only a desktop-release workflow. Do not claim CI on every push
Prediction accuracy is withdrawn pending re-derivation: outcome triggers are not installed in production and predictions are heuristic, not model-derived
The compute mesh is not a '3-node mesh' — the node model is unbounded and in practice one general-purpose worker is active
Android/VisionClaw is NOT a Denizen client — 3 clients shipped, 1 partial
'Org-scoped RLS everywhere' is not accurate — RLS is enabled on 37 of 77 tables, and the service-role key bypasses it
64% of route dispatch sites carry no auth check; the security-tooling endpoints fail open when unconfigured
There is no database backup, no container log rotation, and no external health polling or alerting
AI Prospector and Marketing campaign send are UI-only; do not present them as working features
Do not cite revenue, fundraising or customer-count figures without operator input
Version 1.7.0 is a working label for the July 2026 feature set — operator confirms release numbering
